source_observation: One combined pair. Johnny on left faces up-right toward mermaid, nose close to her face, black top hat tipped left. Mermaid turns more toward camera so both eyes visible while she looks affectionately at Johnny to her left, hair streams right and cyan band crosses crown. Her near arm drops down in front and bends onto his near shoulder/chest, far arm embraces his neck. His arms cradle her waist and upper back. Green tail curls in a large loop downward across his thighs then tip flicks to left at knee height. One near bare foot planted lower center pointing right, farther foot partly obscured behind tail to left. Preserve overlapping tails/coat and exact source viewpoint.
